name: Propylene Glycol Esters of Fatty Acids
aliases: E477, INS 477, propylene glycol esters of fatty acids, propane-1,2-diol esters of fatty acids, propylene glycol fatty acid esters
what_is: An emulsifying and texturising additive consisting of esters of propane-1,2-diol (propylene glycol) with fatty acids, identified in the EU as E477.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E477 because the same additive may be declared using 'propylene glycol' or the systematic 'propane-1,2-diol' wording.
can_1: Detect E477 and the principal propylene-glycol/propanediol ester names.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Determine fatty-acid composition, concentration or manufacturing feedstock from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Confuse E477 with free propylene glycol or with propylene glycol alginate (E405).

sources.label: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 — Union list and conditions of use for food additives
Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — specifications for authorised food additives
